name: com.ezoic.ads
description: Ezoic Ads SDK for Unity. Monetize your Android and iOS game with Ezoic banner, interstitial, and rewarded ads through a simple C# API. Requires the External Dependency Manager for Unity (EDM4U) to resolve the native Android library and iOS CocoaPod, or a manual Gradle dependency / Podfile line (see the README).

samples.description: One MonoBehaviour with an IMGUI control panel that initializes the SDK and loads, shows, hides, and destroys banner, interstitial, and rewarded ads while logging every ad event.
